articles.title: US death row inmate Christa Pike awake and speaking after failed execution, lawyers say
articles.description: Experts and lawyers called the apparent recovery unprecedented, noting she is believed to be the only known person to survive a lethal injection.

articles.title: Three arrested after raid on gang accused of helping migrants pretend to be gay to get asylum
articles.description: Those targeted by Home Office immigration enforcement officers are accused of charging migrants up to £4,500 for fabricated evidence.

articles.title: Watch: Police raid on gang behind fake gay asylum claims
articles.description: The arrests come after a BBC investigation in April revealed that law firms and advisers were helping migrants pose as gay in an effort to get asylum.

articles.title: Tear gas in Paris and Marseille as school protests grow across France
articles.description: Crowds of mainly teenagers called for more resources for schools and an end to what they called police repression.
